reply.text:
That one's not mine to answer. I don't give amounts for hCG or anything else in that category, and dosing for post-cycle therapy is a conversation for a doctor who can run bloodwork and look at what you've been taking. If you're coming off a cycle, please get that checked out by a physician or an endocrinologist rather than going off numbers from the internet.

I'm glad to keep working on the training side with you, including how to structure your lifting while you sort that out.
